title.narrative: Procurment Support for Ministry of Transport of Burkina Faso

description.narrative: The urban mobility and development project for Burkina Faso's secondary towns is part of a partnership between Burkina Faso and the World Bank to enable the country to improve urban mobility, access to basic services and economic opportunities, while building institutional capacity for urban management in the selected secondary towns. These towns were selected on the basis of a number of criteria, including the impact of internally displaced persons on host communities and vulnerability to climate shocks.\n\nThe Government of Burkina Faso, through its Ministry of Transport, Urban Mobility and Road Safety, has requested UNOPS support for the procurement and delivery to Ouagadougou of IT and non-IT equipment. UNOPS will also supervise the training of trainers in the use and maintenance of this equipment.
